summary.en: Live-service football card game in a team of 6–7. Owned backend-facing client work: onboarding, identity, social systems, progression, and realtime features.
summary.ru: Live-service футбольная карточная игра в команде из 6–7 человек. Клиент с backend-интеграциями: онбординг, идентификация, социальные системы, прогрессия и realtime.

en: Owned Firebase rules, indexes, access strategy, and environment configuration.

Shipped push deep links, CRUD Mail Center, Season Pass, and a paginated realtime leaderboard.
Structured profile, settings, ranking UI, and audio architecture.
